info.name: eTech SmartStock – Web Page & POS Admin Portal APIs (v2 Secured)
info.description: Split into two clear top-level folders: 'Web Page' (Next.js website: public anon views + customer JWT endpoints) and 'POS Admin Portal' (staff JWT endpoints + Edge Functions). Set supabaseUrl and supabaseKey in Collection Variables, then run login_customer or login_staff to auto-populate tokens.

item.name: Web Page
item.description: All APIs for the Next.js Customer Website. Public browsing folders use the anon key ({{supabaseKey}}); Checkout, Cart, Account, Quotations & Inquiries use {{customerJwt}} (auto-saved when you run 01 - Auth / login_customer).

item.name: 01 - Auth
item.description: Customer self-registration and login via Supabase Auth. Run login_customer once to auto-save {{customerJwt}}.

request.description: Self-registers a new website customer. Trigger creates a pending_verification row in website_customers and flips to active once email is verified.
Logs in a verified website customer and automatically saves {{customerJwt}}, {{customerRefreshToken}}, and {{websiteCustomerId}}.

item.name: 02 - Categories (Public)
item.description: Read-only public categories view (works with anon key, no login required).

request.description: Returns active product categories from the safe public view web_categories.

item.name: 03 - Products & Catalogue (Public)
item.description: Read-only public product catalogue view with live FIFO selling price and exact stock count (no cost/profit columns).

request.description: Lists active products with selling price, image_url, warranty_period, and available_qty.

item.name: 04 - Promotions & Newsletter (Public)
item.description: Public active website promo codes and newsletter subscription (works with anon key).

request.description: Lists active, public promotional codes for banners and checkout hints.
Subscribes an email to the newsletter safely without direct anon table access.

item.name: 05 - Cart
item.description: Public cart price/stock validation (anon) + persistent authenticated cart CRUD (customerJwt).

request.description: Revalidates browser cart items against live FIFO prices and stock before login/checkout.

item.name: 06 - Checkout & Orders (Customer JWT)
item.description: Requires verified customer login ({{customerJwt}}). Prices, stock, and coupon limits are calculated server-side.

request.description: Atomic server-side checkout RPC. Validates stock, calculates FIFO prices, applies coupon limits, and creates website_orders + website_order_items.

item.name: 07 - Account, Profile, Addresses & Wishlist (Customer JWT)
item.description: Customer-owned account endpoints (RLS restricts strictly to own rows).

item.name: 08 - Quotations & Inquiries (Customer JWT)
item.description: Customer quotation requests and Contact / Mahamu / Service & Repair inquiries.

item.name: 09 - Payment Webhooks (Server-to-Server)
item.description: Edge Functions called by WebXPay and Koko gateways using HMAC-SHA256 signature headers.

item.name: POS Admin Portal
item.description: All APIs for the POS Admin Portal (Figma/Vite SPA). Run 01 - Staff Auth & Provisioning / login_staff first — it automatically saves {{staffJwt}} for all POS requests below.

item.name: 01 - Staff Auth & Provisioning
item.description: Staff login via Supabase Auth + Owner-only Edge Function for creating/deactivating/resetting staff accounts.

request.description: Logs in a POS staff member (username@smartapparel.local or linked email) and automatically saves {{staffJwt}} and {{staffRefreshToken}}.

exec: console.log('Saved staffJwt | account_kind:', payload.account_kind, '| role:', payload.role_name);

request.description: Safely clears must_change_password for the logged-in staff user after changing their temporary password.
Owner/Admin only. Creates a Supabase Auth user with app_metadata.account_kind='staff' and inserts into public.users.

item.name: 02 - Web Operations (Orders, Quotations, Inquiries & Coupons)
item.description: Staff endpoints used by WebOperationsManagement.tsx in the Admin Portal.
